about: Settings for the Graded Heat bot (scripts/graded_heat.py). Edit and commit to change what it watches. Nothing here touches the cards on the site.
max_slab_price_about: The most you'd pay for one slab (PSA 10 or PSA 9). All three slab bots skip slabs over this in both grades (no requests spent on them) and the Graded Slabs tab only lists slabs with a PSA 10 or PSA 9 at or under it. Change the number and commit; the next morning's runs use it. CardPrice still re-checks over-cap slabs every cp_over_cap_recheck_days days so ones that drop back under come back.

sources.about: How the four slab bots share work (graded/sources.json). skip_if_other_checked_days: the three eBay-sales bots (tcgapi.net, PokemonPriceTracker, pokemon-api.com) skip a slab another one of them checked this recently (heating-up slabs excepted: they get a second source on purpose). disagree_pct: flag a slab when two of them disagree by more than this. psa9_share_of_psa10_guess: when only the PSA 10 price is known, guess the PSA 9 at this share of it for the cap test. price_fresh_days: prices older than this aren't used for the cap test.

cp_about: CardPrice.com (scripts/cardprice_bot.py): free open API, 600 requests/min. ~2 requests per slab, so 400 slabs is ~800 a day (the whole pool about every 4 days).
ta_about: tcgapi.net eBay sold comps (scripts/tcgapi_bot.py, secret TCGAPI_KEY). Free plan: about 1,000 requests a day; one request per slab. ta_max_per_day is a hard cap the bot counts itself. It re-checks each slab every ta_recheck_days (heating-up slabs every ta_hot_recheck_days) and keeps the last ta_keep_sales clean sales per grade for the charts.
pa_about: pokemon-api.com via RapidAPI (scripts/pokemon_api_bot.py, secret POKEMON_API_KEY). Free plan: 100 requests. pa_max_per_day / pa_max_per_month are hard caps the bot never passes, and it also stops when RapidAPI says only pa_keep_free requests are left, so it can't run into paid overage. If your RapidAPI plan page says the 100 is per DAY, raise pa_max_per_day to about 90; if it's per MONTH, leave 3 a day / 95 a month.
priority_about: Your Pokémon, most important first. Slabs of these that are on the verge show first; other popular Pokémon (the 'popular' list in discovery_config.json) come after. The bot also checks these first.
